sources.title: Qwen Models (Qwen3MoE, Qwen3-Next, Qwen3.5, Qwen3-Coder-Next)
sources.snippet: This page provides technical documentation for deploying the Qwen model family using KTransformers. It covers high-performance inference for Qwen3MoE using Intel AMX optimizations, the linear-attention based Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B, the massive Qwen3.5-MoE-400B, and the code-specialized Qwen3-Coder-Next.
